title: Volato Group, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026 announcing entry into Share Exchange Agreements with M2i Global shareholders, pursuant to which the Company will issue 5,407,499 shares of Class A common stock in exchange for 48,044,912 shares of M2i Global common stock.
key_points: Volato Group, Inc. (SOAR, NYSE American) entered into Share Exchange Agreements with Charcoal Hill Family Limited Partnership, Douglas Cole, and Clearthark Capital Partners, LLC
The Company agreed to issue 5,407,499 shares of Class A common stock to M2i Global shareholders in exchange for 48,044,912 M2i Global shares
Implied per-share value is $0.2701 for Volato shares and $0.0304 for M2i shares
The Volato Shares were issued in reliance upon exemptions from registration under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and Regulation D
The Company agreed to file a registration statement within 60 days to register resale of the Volato Shares
Volato Group is an emerging growth company as defined under SEC rules
